tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Look up a place by name or address and return matching places with their coordinates. Use it to confirm an ambiguous start before generating routes.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "generate_routes" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
